```python
# Python: DP-SGD sketch for federated learning
def dp_sgd_step(model, batch, noise_multiplier, l2_norm_clip):
    # Compute gradients with clipping
    grads = compute_gradients(model, batch)
    clipped_grads = clip_gradients(grads, l2_norm_clip)
    # Add noise for differential privacy
    noisy_grads = add_gaussian_noise(clipped_grads, noise_multiplier)
    return apply_gradients(model, noisy_grads)
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Assesses the ability to design a safe, scalable NLQ-to-SQL system for multi-tenant data with strict privacy, governance, and performance constraints, along with practical testing and rollback strategies.

## Key Concepts

- **NLQ-to-SQL translation with guardrails**: Converting natural language queries to SQL while preventing unsafe operations
- **Multi-tenant access control**: Row-level security (RLS) and column-level policies to enforce data isolation
- **Retrieval augmentation**: Schema catalogs and embeddings to improve translation accuracy
- **Guardrails**: Restricting operations to SELECT-only (blocking DDL), enforcing query cost and latency caps
- **Drift detection**: Monitoring translation quality over time
- **Secure rollout**: Canary deployments and rollbacks for model updates

## Code Example

```javascript
function translateToSql(nl, schema, policies) {
  const relevantSchema = retrieveSchema(nl, schema);
  const filteredSchema = applyPolicies(relevantSchema, policies);
  const sqlPlan = generateSql(nl, filteredSchema);
  const validatedSql = validateAndGuardrail(sqlPlan);
  return { sql: validatedSql, plan: explainPlan(sqlPlan) };
}
```

## Testing Strategy

- **Unit tests**: Validate individual components (schema retrieval, policy enforcement, SQL generation)
- **Integration tests**: End-to-end flows with mocked Snowflake instances
- **Property-based tests**: Generate diverse NL queries and verify SQL correctness and safety
- **Shadow mode**: Run translations in parallel with live queries to compare results before production
- **Chaos testing**: Validate behavior under Snowflake latency, errors, and network partitions

## Rollback Strategy

- **Feature flags**: Canary deployments with gradual traffic shifting (1% → 10% → 100%)
- **Automated regression detection**: Compare query results between versions; halt rollout on drift
- **A/B validation**: Parallel run with automated diffing of outputs
- **One-click rollback**: Immediate revert to previous model version via flag toggle
- **Audit trail**: Full versioning of model artifacts with rollback metadata

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates practical NLP extraction skills under real-world constraints typical of job platforms.

## Key Concepts
- Multilingual information extraction from user-generated content
- Tiny on-device models, inference optimization, and quantization techniques
- Code-switching handling, data labeling workflows, and privacy-by-design architecture

## Code Example
```javascript
function extractJob(posting) {
  const title = (posting.split('title:')[1] || '').split('\n')[0].trim();
  const location = (posting.split('location:')[1] || '').split('\n')[0].trim();
  const skills = (posting.split('skills:')[1] || '').split('\n')[0].trim();
  const remote = /remote|home.?office|telecommut/i.test(posting);
  const seniority = /senior|junior|lead|manager|intern/i.test(posting) ? 
    posting.match(/senior|junior|lead|manager|intern/i)[0] : 'mid';
  
  return { title, location, skills, remote, seniority };
}
```

## Labeling Plan
- Use heuristic-labeled data from structured job feeds as initial training data
- Apply human-in-the-loop validation for ambiguous cases
- Implement confidence thresholds to route low-confidence extractions to rules or human review

## Latency & Privacy
- On-device inference ensures <100 ms latency with quantized TinyBERT
- No data leaves the device, satisfying privacy requirements

## Offline Evaluation
- Test on held-out multilingual dataset covering all three languages and code-switching scenarios
- Measure precision/recall per field and overall schema completeness

## Staged Rollout
- Phase 1: Rule-based extraction only (baseline)
- Phase 2: Hybrid model + rules on 5% of traffic
- Phase 3: Full rollout with A/B testing and monitoring

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design lightweight, privacy-conscious NLP with practical constraints. 

## Key Concepts
- Text normalization: emoji/slang handling
- Lightweight bilingual features; on-device constraints
- Hybrid rule+ML approach; latency and privacy trade-offs

## Code Example
```python
import re
EMOJI_MAP = {":)": "smile"}
def normalize(text):
  for k,v in EMOJI_MAP.items():
    text = text.replace(k, v)
  text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", "", text)
  return text.lower()
```
